thread:
Maria (CSM): Heads up — weekly account health sync. Need to coordinate proactive notices for three accounts that are approaching our soft rate-guardrail this week. Quick plan below.

Ajay (AM): Which accounts are we talking about? Can we stagger sends so CS doesn't get overloaded?

Maria (CSM): VeraPay, SageFrame, CobaltRetail. VeraPay is already at 82% of soft guardrail, SageFrame spiked to 94% during trial flows, CobaltRetail creeping up to 75% with weekend traffic.

Sam (Ops): FYI metrics from last 24h — VeraPay: +18% MoM tokens, p50 latency 120ms, errors 0.6%. SageFrame: +45% MoM, p50 latency 210ms, errors 2.8% (some 429s). CobaltRetail: +9% MoM, p50 95ms, errors 0.3%.

Leo (Eng): For SageFrame we can enable a 72h burst window (priority slot) and add an auto-rolloff. Need a config PR and a runbook entry for rollback if errors jump.

Irene (CSM): Can someone draft the customer-facing note? Short + clear, call out recommended actions.

Maria (CSM): Draft for review — feel free to tweak:```Hi <Account Team>,

We noticed increased usage over the past 48 hours and wanted to give you a heads up before you hit your soft rate guardrail. To avoid throttling, we can:
1) Temporarily increase your burst allocation for 72 hours (we can enable this on request), or
2) Help throttle/backpressure client-side to smooth peaks (we have best-practice snippets).

If you'd like the temporary burst, reply to this thread with "Enable burst" and we'll apply it within 1 hour. If you'd like engineering help, we'll set up a 30-min pairing call.

Docs & links: https://redwood.ai/docs/quotas and our throttling snippets: https://redwood.ai/devex/throttling

Thanks,
Maria (CSM)```

Ajay (AM): Looks good. Recommend sending to VeraPay now (they're closest) and SageFrame after we confirm the 72h burst and runbook. CobaltRetail we can notify Wed morning — lower priority. Stagger schedule to keep CS workload manageable.

Sam (Ops): I'll open the config PR: `PR #13422` and the runbook ticket `RB-667`. I'll also set up a short monitor: alert if error rate > 5% in 10m window to auto-rolloff.

Leo (Eng): I'll be on-call for rollback support for the SageFrame burst. Tag me on the PR and I'll watch logs.

Irene (CSM): Owners assigned for outreach: VeraPay -> Maria, SageFrame -> Irene, CobaltRetail -> Ajay. I'll queue the pairing call slot for SageFrame once Ops confirms PR.

Ajay (AM): Add a billing note in the message about projected spend: VeraPay +18% (estimate $2.3k extra), SageFrame +45% (trial surge, estimate $6.8k extra), CobaltRetail +9% (estimate $700). Include a contact for billing questions.

automations-bot: /remind #customer-success to send VeraPay notice on 2026-04-06 09:00 PT — scheduled by Maria (CSM).

Maria (CSM): Thanks team. I'll push the VeraPay notice now and update the weekly health doc with the burst windows and PR links. :thumbsup:

Sam (Ops): Confirmed PR opened, monitoring in place.

Leo (Eng): Ready to support rollback.

Irene (CSM): I'll draft the SageFrame customer message with the pairing invite and share in this thread for approval.

Maria (CSM): Perfect — closing the loop here. We'll reconvene in tomorrow's sync if anything escalates. :white_check_mark:
